title: Ward
description: The citizen's geography. A ward has a centre and a radius. The user app resolves its own ward by which ward's circle contains it, or by a manual picker. PRD-2 section 3.3.

nameGu.description: Gujarati name. The user app and the driver app both need it.

radiusM.description: The circle's radius in metres. The arrival alert measures from the BOUNDARY, so the effective check is radiusM + ARRIVAL_ALERT_RADIUS_M.

routeId.description: Which route serves this ward. THE JOIN KEY for the user app. The user app listens only to vans where routeId matches.

inspectorId.description: The staff doc that owns this ward. The target of missedCollectionAlert.

escalationTo.description: The staff doc to escalate to at level 1.
